ARRESTED AND BROUGHT INTO JAIL. Low intimate rear three-quarter view in a small county jail doorway. The same charcoal-robed traveler is being escorted forward into a barred stone cell by one sober Song-era constable in muted navy cloth uniform and a plain black cap; the constable's hand holds the traveler's upper arm, firmly but without brutality. Another jailer behind an open heavy timber-bar door holds a simple key ring. The traveler's face entirely hidden, head slightly bowed; worn straw hat hangs against their back, compact cloth pack at hip. No swords at throats, no blood, no torture or exaggerated humiliation. Cool daylight from one high slit falls across a bare timber sleeping platform with thin straw mat inside the cell, rough stone floor and shadowed bars. Focus on the threshold and human gesture; cinematic close scene, not a dungeon panorama. Exactly three adults, natural hands, grounded physical restraint. Mood: weight of consequence and narrowing freedom.
